title: Grey Hand Block Print Cotton Kurta Set for Women with Kota Doria Dupatta
color_custom: Soft dove grey with mustard-olive & charcoal florals
description:
Quiet luxury, the Jaipur way. This dove-grey kurta set is hand block printed by our karigars, one carved wooden block at a time, with sweeping mustard-olive and charcoal florals. It is paired with an airy Kota Doria dupatta – also block printed by hand and finished with a fine gold border and tassels. Calm, refined and made to be worn again and again.

✦ The Details
• Straight-cut kurta with a notched round neck and printed placket
• 3/4 sleeves and hem finished with contrast printed borders
• Matching straight pants in a small leaf block print
• Kota Doria dupatta with hand block print, gold border and tassels
• Calf-length kurta, side slits for easy movement
• 3-piece set: kurta, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
Kurta and pants are 100% cotton – soft, breathable and kind to skin in every season. The dupatta is Kota Doria, Rajasthan's famous chequered weave, known for being feather-light and sheer. Every motif is printed by hand, so small variations in colour and alignment are a mark of true handmade craft, not a flaw.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual size, or use our Fit Finder for a recommendation. Between sizes? Size up for a relaxed look – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your exact measurements at no extra cost.

✦ How to Style It
For a day wedding or puja, add oxidised silver jhumkas and gold juttis. For office, drop the dupatta and wear the kurta and pants with block heels and a tan tote. In winter abroad, layer a long camel coat over it – the grey and mustard look beautiful together.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in our own Jaipur unit – we send you photos of your piece being made
• Free custom fit – share your measurements and we stitch it for you
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
